title: Disentangling Societal Inequality from Model Biases: Gender Inequality in Divorce Court Proceedings

bias_targets.methodology: Modified Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) that distinguishes between perpetrator and victim roles using POS tagging; Natural Language Inference (NLI) text entailment gap analysis using counterfactual gender identifier flipping; and cloze (fill-in-the-blank) tests on LLMs to evaluate the probability of assigning male versus female terms to agent and theme roles for power-implying verbs.
